info.name: ShabbosRent API — Full v3

item.description: Nedarim Plus iframe flow. Create intents, verify, webhooks, admin view.

request.description: Call after iframe completes. paymentType: LISTING|SWAP|REPORT_RENTED

item.name: Nedarim Webhook Callback (POST — from Nedarim servers)

request.description: Called by Nedarim servers. No auth required.

item.name: 7. Wishlist (/wishlist)
item.description: Toggle apartments in/out of the user wishlist.

request.description: Adds if not present, removes if already there.

item.name: 8. Reviews (/review)
item.description: Submit reviews (PENDING). Admin approves. Only APPROVED shown publicly.

request.description: Triggers admin Socket.IO alert for moderation.

item.name: 9. Swap Preference (/swap-preference)
item.description: Configure swap preferences and discover matches.

request.description: Returns apartments matching the user criteria.

item.name: 10. Swaps (/swap)
item.description: Apartment swap requests between users.

request.description: User own apt auto-detected. Target must have swap enabled.
Recipient only. status: PENDING|APPROVED|REJECTED. APPROVED triggers Socket.IO to both.

item.description: Public contact form. Admin reads submissions.

request.description: apartmentId OR receiverId required. channel: VOICE|WHATSAPP|EMAIL. Returns Twilio call SID + masked number.
apartmentId OR receiverId required. Generates wa.me link or sends via Twilio WhatsApp.

item.name: Twilio TwiML Voice Webhook (GET — called by Twilio)

item.name: 📡 Socket.IO Reference
item.description:
Connect: io('http://localhost:5000')
Registration events:
  socket.emit('register', userId)         -- personal alerts
  socket.emit('join_room', 'admin')       -- admin room
  socket.emit('join_room', 'ambassadors') -- ambassador room

Server emits:
  admin_alert        -- admin room, all admin events
  ambassador_alert   -- ambassadors room
  new_alert          -- specific user (by userId)
  newAlert           -- global broadcast (every persisted alert)
  notification       -- specific user (alias)

Business trigger table:
  Apartment listed          -> admin_alert + newAlert
  Ambassador registered     -> admin_alert + newAlert
  Referral attribution      -> admin_alert + ambassador new_alert + newAlert
  Report rented confirmed   -> admin_alert + newAlert
  Swap APPROVED             -> admin_alert + new_alert (both parties)
  Payout requested          -> admin_alert + newAlert
  Review submitted          -> admin_alert + newAlert (pending moderation)
  User signup via ref link  -> admin_alert + ambassador new_alert
